title: Kagamine Len — Bursting With Power!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm, this is a pretty mellow song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't know Len had such songs in his repertoire.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The first time I heard this song, I was surprised too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always thought Len was a rock singer, but after searching around, I found out he sings in many different styles...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even a mellow and mature song like this one suits him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I could listen to this forever...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, look at this, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is everyone having fun?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin! I'm still singing here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But the next song is a duet of ours, right?
So it's okay for me to come out...oh wait.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe, I forgot my microphone!
Lend me yours, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So that you can hog it for yourself?
No, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Len and Rin are so close to each other.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! When you see them together, it gives you this sense of reassurance and peace, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because the two of them being together feels very natural to us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly. They're both Kagamine, after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't know...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't see Rin and Len as twins or family members at all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe...you see them as partners?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, that's it! That's exactly what I was thinking, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Partners who uplift and support each other.
That's the image I have of them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You really want them to stay close even if they fight, because they're partners.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess it can't be helped...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
How about a mic relay, then?
We'll pass each other the mic when it gets to our own parts.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
Let's do that, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright! Don't forget to time it correctly!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It'll be fine! Who do you think we are?
We'll ace the timing, don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, thanks for waiting, everyone! Let the music begin!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, perfect timing, just like they said.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's what happens when you have an unbreakable bond!
